section_1.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Tangent vs. The Area
section_1.content: Briefly review the two main problems of Calculus: The slope of a curve (Derivative) and the area under a curve (Integral). Visualize them as 'Zooming in' versus 'Accumulating'.
section_1.example: Visualize a bird flying: The derivative is its instantaneous velocity (a snapshot), while the integral is the total distance covered (the sum of all snapshots).

section_2.title: The Inverse Mechanism: Cancellation
section_2.content: Explain that integration and differentiation are inverse processes. If you take the derivative of a function and then integrate it, you return to the original state, akin to 'undoing' an operation.
section_2.example: Imagine a robot moving along a line. Its position is f(x). Differentiation finds its velocity (f'). Integrating the velocity function retrieves the original position function f(x).

section_3.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (Visualization)
section_3.content: Introduce the connection using a graphical animation: An area function A(x) representing the area accumulated from a to x. Show how the rate of change of this 'area bucket' is exactly the height of the function at point x.
section_3.example: A water tank filling up. The derivative of the 'Total Water Volume' (Integral) at any moment is exactly the 'Flow Rate' (Function) at that specific time.

section_4.title: Practical Application & Summary
section_4.content: Demonstrate that knowing the 'rate of change' (derivative) allows us to reconstruct the 'total accumulation' (integral) using the Anti-derivative. Summarize the link as the 'Fundamental Theorem of Calculus'.
section_4.example: Use a character, 'Explorer Alex', who tracks their speed throughout the day. By integrating that speed graph, Alex can calculate exactly how many miles they traveled across the mountain range.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
